title: citharexylum fruticosum f. subvillosum
intro: Citharexylum fruticosum f. subvillosum, commonly known as the subhairy fringe tree, is a plant species within the Verbenaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, thanks to its numerous health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant is known to exhibit therapeutic actions like reducing pain, lowering fever, and improving digestive health, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents in Citharexylum fruticosum f. subvillosum contribute to its medicinal properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
